title: Add fine-tuning eval gates and promotion rollback workflow
description: Implement objective-based automatic evaluation for tool calls, markdown quality, and taxonomy behavior; gate promotion and keep explicit rollback metadata.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to ensure model promotion is evidence-gated and reversible instead of trust-based.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive reverified training harness false-positive success: real inference/LoRA failures fall back to simulation and final passed status requires only records >= 2. Non-simulated runs must fail closed or be explicitly non-promotable; objective tool-call/schema/behavior gates are required.
